units.source_text: 他执笔的手开始颤抖了，口水也不自觉的流了下来。

en.t: The hand with which he held the pen began to tremble, and drool ran down without his noticing.

units.source_text: 除了0.8毫克的佛罗那之外，他的头脑再也没有清醒过。

en.t: Except under 0.8 milligrams of Veronal, his mind was never clear again.

units.source_text: 即使是这样，他也不过清醒半小时或一小时。

en.t: Even then, he was clear-headed for no more than half an hour or an hour.

units.source_text: 在幽暗他挨着时光，就好像是拄着一把崩了刃的细剑当拐杖。

en.t: In the dimness he endured the passing time, as though leaning on a thin sword with a chipped blade for a cane.
